checks.note: Within this file the mechanics hold: purchasePack calls paymentGateway.chargeAndCapture outside any try (the try covers only createPurchase), and nothing is persisted before the charge, so an unknown-outcome throw leaves no purchase row and no stripe_refund_failures row. But the finding's required verification — that ChargeOutcomeReconciler.java has no pack handling, that StripePaymentGateway.chargeAndCapture throws ChargeOutcomeUnknownException without recording anything, and that no sweeper scans pack-prefixed idempotency keys — depends on files not shown and no file tools are available, so the end-to-end consequence (money permanently untracked) cannot be confirmed or refuted.

In confirmPurchase's catch block, `if (e?.response) attemptKey = null` clears the key on any HTTP response regardless of status, so the verification caveat is moot: whatever status ApiAdvice maps ChargeOutcomeUnknownException to (and a proxy 504) is still an `e.response` and resets the key, contradicting the comment above `attemptKey` that a fresh key is minted only on success or definite failure. The retry then mints a new key via `attemptKey ??= newAttemptKey()`, bypassing idempotent replay and allowing a second charge.

The retry half is real in this file: createPurchase does no refund/dispute check, and after chargeAndCapture replays the captured intent, findByStripePaymentIntentId (the guard after line 131) finds no row, so a full-session pack commits. But the finding's verification caveat — that StripeWebhookService.handleEventAtomically acknowledges the event when revokeForCharge returns -1 without throwing (ChargeDisputeWebhookService.java:224-227) — depends on webhook code not shown here, so the acknowledged-and-never-redelivered consequence cannot be settled from this file alone.

The D8 recheck in pausePackTransactional re-runs findConflictingBookingsForPause as a plain non-locking SELECT under only the pack's own row lock, while the booking path (findActivePackId, readOnly, plain findActivePacks — no-lock fact also stated in the D8 comment itself) never touches that lock; under READ COMMITTED an uncommitted concurrent booking INSERT is invisible to the recheck and, once both commit, sits inside [pausedFrom, pausedUntil) where deductSession's isPausedAt guard throws payment.packPaused on accept.

getOrCreateStripeCustomer's unconditional save(existing) of a detached snapshot (line ~356-359, non-transactional purchasePack) matches the claimed trigger, but the consequence depends on code not shown: the StripeCustomer entity (whether it lacks @Version/@DynamicUpdate and has a lastPaymentIntentId field at all — this file never touches that column), the concurrent write at StripePaymentGateway.java:201-202, and CashOutService.refundTarget's stale-intent fallback, which the finding's verification caveat requires checking.

refundSessionToWallet does use a racy existsByReferenceIdAndType(bookingId, BOOKING_REFUND) check before writeLedgerEntry with only the pack row locked, but whether any cancellation flow enqueues both the pack-restore event and a money-refund outbox event for the same booking, and whether any migration adds a unique index on (reference_id) WHERE type='BOOKING_REFUND', cannot be verified from this file — the outbox enqueue code and migrations (V199/V208 and later) are not available here.

getOrCreateStripeCustomer's findById(parentId).orElseGet(...) is an unguarded check-then-act with no lock, no idempotency key on paymentGateway.createStripeCustomer, and purchasePack is intentionally non-transactional, so two concurrent first purchases both create live Stripe customers and one is left unreferenced whichever save wins. The caveat's questions (payment-method attachment inside createStripeCustomer, orphan reconciliation) live in the PaymentGateway implementation, not this file, but they only affect the off-session-charge tail, not the confirmed duplicate-customer race.
